scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 55-bet): Laura's matni 10 gap - so'zma-so'z skan bilan mos (Tel.: 6640306, £25, 11:00-23:00). 3-mashq 4 savoli, qalin so'zlar (family restaurant, Don't miss the chance, home-made, dessert, slice, bowl, friendly, occasion, busy, don't forget) mos. Speaking jadvali 8 qator to'ldirilgan. Ex.4 ro'yxati 10 so'z / 10 bo'shliq mos. Ex.5 rasmlari: qoshiq, likopcha, pichoq, vilka, tova - javoblar spoon/plate/knife/fork/frying-pan bilan mos. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text about Laura's Restaurant.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MATN — RESTORAN HAQIDAGI TAQRIZ (a review).

TUZILISHI (to'rt xatboshi):
  1) nomi, turi, joyi, ish vaqti
  2) taomlar va shirinliklar
  3) narx va xizmat
  4) tavsiya (recommendation)

Bu tuzilish 57-betdagi yozma ish uchun namuna bo'ladi.

QALIN YOZILGAN SO'ZLAR (3c-mashqda tushuntiriladi):
  family restaurant, Don't miss the chance, home-made,
  dessert, slice, bowl, friendly, occasion, busy, don't forget

sentences.en: Laura's is the new family restaurant on Bridge Street and it's open for lunch and dinner every day.
sentences.uz: 'Laura's' — Bridge ko'chasidagi yangi oilaviy restoran va u har kuni tushlik hamda kechki ovqat uchun ochiq.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: a family restaurant = oilaviy restoran
(bolalar bilan borish mumkin, narxi o'rtacha).
'Laura's' — egalik apostrofi bilan restoran nomi.
'open FOR lunch' — 'for' predlogi shart.

sentences.en: The food is very well cooked.
sentences.noteUz:
'well cooked' = yaxshi pishirilgan.
'well' — RAVISH ('good cooked' XATO).

sentences.en: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce, and lots of different salads.
sentences.uz: Tanlash uchun juda ko'p mazali taomlar bor: qalampirli bifshteks, qovurilgan tovuq, guruch bilan baliq, pomidor sho'rvasi, quyuq pomidor sousli makaron va turli-tuman salatlar.
sentences.noteUz:
'such as' = masalan, ...kabi (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.
'rich' bu yerda = quyuq, to'yimli (boy emas!).
'a dish' = taom (bir tur).

sentences.en: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread — it's delicious!
sentences.uz: 'Laura's' ning uyda pishirilgan nonini tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang — u juda mazali!
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  Don't miss the chance = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang
  home-made = uyda tayyorlangan (home + made)
'delicious' = juda mazali ('tasty' dan kuchliroq).

sentences.en: For dessert, have a slice of the chef's superb apple pie, or a bowl of Laura's special ice-cream.
sentences.uz: Shirinlikka oshpazning ajoyib olmali pirogidan bir bo'lak yoki 'Laura's' ning maxsus muzqaymog'idan bir kosa oling.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  dessert /dɪˈzɜːt/ = shirinlik (ovqatdan keyin)
  a slice = bir bo'lak (pirog, non, pitsa uchun)
  a bowl = kosa, piyola
'a chef' /ʃef/ = oshpaz (restoranning bosh oshpazi).
'superb' = ajoyib.

sentences.en: A meal for two people costs about £25.
sentences.uz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 25 funt turadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'A meal' — birlik ega → COSTS.
'£25' = 'twenty-five pounds' deb o'qiladi.

sentences.en: The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.
sentences.uz: Xizmat a'lo darajada, ofitsiantlar juda yordamchan va do'stona.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'Z: friendly = do'stona, iliq muomalali.
'helpful' = yordamchan (help + -ful).
'a waiter' = ofitsiant (erkak); 'a waitress' = ofitsiant (ayol).

sentences.en: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
sentences.uz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

sentences.en: Laura's is a great restaurant for any occasion, but it is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
sentences.uz: 'Laura's' har qanday tadbir uchun ajoyib restoran, lekin u juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR:
  an occasion = tadbir, munosabat (tug'ilgan kun, yubiley)
  busy = gavjum, band
  don't forget = unutmang
'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
'first' bu yerda = oldindan, avvaldan.

'Tel.' = telephone number ning qisqartmasi.
'Enjoy your meal!' — unit sarlavhasi ham shu.

exercises.instructionEn: Find any foods included in the pictures on p. 54.
exercises.explanationUz:
Matndagi ovqat nomlarini 54-betdagi rasmlar bilan solishtiring.
O'n ikkitasi ikkala joyda ham bor.

items.textEn: Matnda ham, 54-betdagi rasmda ham bor bo'lgan ovqatlar:
items.answer: steak, pepper, chicken, fish, rice, tomato soup, pasta, tomato sauce, salad, bread, apple pie, ice-cream
items.whyUz:
MATNDAGI TAOMLAR:
  pepper steak    → 54-betda 'steak' va 'pepper' bor
  roast chicken   → 'roast chicken' bor
  fish with rice  → 'grilled fish' va 'rice' bor
  tomato soup     → 'tomato soup' bor
  pasta           → 'pasta' bor
  tomato sauce    → 'tomato sauce' bor
  salads          → 'salad' bor
  home-made bread → 'bread' bor
  apple pie       → 'apple pie' bor
  ice-cream       → 'ice-cream' bor

exercises.explanationUz: Javoblarni matndan toping. To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

items.textEn: 1  What is the name of the new restaurant?
items.whyUz:
Restoran nomi — 'Laura's' (egalik apostrofi bilan).
To'liq javob: 'The name of the new restaurant is Laura's.'

items.textEn: 2  What dishes can you have there?
items.answer: You can have pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce and lots of different salads.
items.hintUz: Ikkinchi xatboshidagi 'such as' dan keyingi ro'yxat
items.whyUz:
'such as' dan keyin taomlar ro'yxati keladi.
Home-made bread ham bor, lekin u asosiy taom emas — qo'shimcha.

items.textEn: 3  What can you have for dessert?
items.answer: You can have a slice of apple pie or a bowl of special ice-cream.
items.whyUz:
Ikki variant: 'a slice of apple pie' YOKI 'a bowl of ice-cream'.
Tanlov bo'lgani uchun 'OR' ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 4  What time does the restaurant open and close?
items.answer: It opens at eleven in the morning and closes at eleven in the evening.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening'.
Savolda 'open' va 'close' fe'llari → javobda ham fe'l bilan:
  'It OPENS at ...' va 'CLOSES at ...' (birlik ega → -S).

exercises.explanationUz: Matndagi 10 ta qalin so'z — restoran mavzusining asosiy lug'ati.

items.whyUz: Narxi o'rtacha, muhiti tinch, bolalar uchun menyusi bor restoran.

'to miss' = o'tkazib yubormoq; 'a chance' = imkoniyat.
Buyruq gapning inkori — reklama va tavsiyalarda ko'p ishlatiladi.

home + made — chiziqcha bilan qo'shma sifat.
Zavodda emas, qo'lda tayyorlangan degani.

Talaffuz: /dɪˈzɜːt/ — urg'u IKKINCHI bo'g'inda.
DIQQAT: 'desert' /ˈdezət/ = CHO'L — butunlay boshqa so'z!

'a slice of pie/bread/pizza/cake' = bir bo'lak.
Yupqa, kesilgan bo'lak ma'nosida.

'a bowl of ice-cream/soup/rice' = bir kosa.
Talaffuz: /bəʊl/ — 'boul'.

friend + -ly. '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT (ravish emas).
40-betda 'friendly to people' bor edi.

'for any occasion' = har qanday tadbir uchun.
Talaffuz: /əˈkeɪʒn/.

Talaffuz: /ˈbɪzi/ — 'bizi' (yozilishi aldamchi!).
Restoran haqida — odam ko'p degani.

'to forget' = unutmoq. Buyruq gapning inkori.
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and complete the table, then talk about Laura's.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va jadvalni to'ldiring, so'ng 'Laura's' haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — MATNNI TARTIBGA SOLISH USULI.

SAKKIZ QATOR:
  Name/Type ......... nomi va turi
  Location .......... joyi
  Main Course/Dishes  asosiy taomlar
  Desserts .......... shirinliklar
  Cost .............. narxi
  Service ........... xizmat
  Opening hours ..... ish vaqti
  Recommendation .... tavsiya

BIRINCHI QATOR KITOBDA BERILGAN:
  Name/Type: Laura's / family restaurant

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA NUTQ:
  'Laura's is a new family restaurant on Bridge Street ...'

Bu jadval 57-betdagi yozma ish uchun REJA bo'ladi.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob.

Matnda: 'on Bridge Street'.
Ko'cha nomi oldida ON.

items.answer: pepper steak, roast chicken, fish with rice, tomato soup, pasta with rich tomato sauce, different salads, home-made bread
items.whyUz:
'a main course' = asosiy taom (ikkinchi taom).
Matndagi 'such as' dan keyingi ro'yxat.

items.answer: a slice of apple pie, a bowl of special ice-cream
items.whyUz: Ikki shirinlik varianti berilgan.
Matnda: 'A meal for two people costs about £25.'

items.answer: excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'The service is excellent, with very helpful and friendly waiters.'

items.answer: from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening
items.whyUz: 'opening hours' = ish vaqti (do'kon, restoran uchun).

items.answer: Don't forget to book a table first. (Tel.: 6640306)
items.whyUz:
'a recommendation' = tavsiya.
Restoran gavjum bo'lgani uchun oldindan stol band qilish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Then talk about Laura's. Start like this: Laura's is a new family restaurant on Bridge Street ...
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng 'Laura's' haqida gapiring. Shunday boshlang: Laura's is a new family restaurant on Bridge Street ...

Jadvaldagi har bir qatorni gapga aylantiring.
41 va 45-betlardagi jadvallar bilan bir xil usul.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: roast, apple, don't miss, helpful, home-made,
         tasty, book, tomato, pepper, special

Barcha iboralar 'Laura's' matnidan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  1–8 — otdan OLDIN turadi → SIFAT yoki OT
  9 — 'to' dan keyin → FE'L
  10 — 'the chance' dan oldin → FE'L (buyruq)

items.hintUz: Qora achchiq ziravor bilan pishirilgan go'sht
items.whyUz:
'pepper steak' = qalampirli bifshteks.
Gap: There is pepper steak on the menu.

'tomato sauce' = pomidor sousi.
DIQQAT: birinchi ot BIRLIKDA — 'tomatoes sauce' XATO.
Gap: I like pasta with rich tomato sauce.

'apple pie' = olmali pirog.
Gap: For dessert, have a slice of apple pie.

'special ice-cream' = maxsus muzqaymoq.
Gap: Try Laura's special ice-cream.

'helpful waiters' = yordamchan ofitsiantlar.
help + -ful = yordamchan.
Gap: The waiters are very helpful and friendly.

'roast chicken' = qovurilgan tovuq.
Gap: I often have roast chicken for dinner.

'home-made bread' = uyda pishirilgan non.
Gap: Laura's home-made bread is delicious.

'tasty dishes' = mazali taomlar.
taste (ta'm) + -y = mazali.
Gap: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from.

'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
DIQQAT: 'a book' = kitob (OT), 'to book' = band qilmoq (FE'L).
Gap: Don't forget to book a table first.

items.hintUz: Imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermaslik haqidagi buyruq
items.whyUz:
'Don't miss the chance' = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang.
Gap: Don't miss the chance to try our home-made bread!

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: knife, fork, plate, frying-pan, spoon

OSHXONA VA DASTURXON BUYUMLARI:
  a spoon ....... qoshiq (dumaloq, chuqurchali)
  a fork ........ vilka (uchli tishlari bor)
  a knife ....... pichoq (tig'i bor)
  a plate ....... tarelka (yassi)
  a frying-pan .. qovurish tovasi (dastasi bor)

RASMLARDAGI TARTIB:
  1 — qoshiq   2 — tarelka   3 — pichoq
  4 — vilka    5 — qovurish tovasi

DIQQAT — TALAFFUZ:
  knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI!
  Ko'pligi: knife → KNIVES (f → ves)

items.whyUz:
Sho'rva SUYUQ → qoshiq kerak.
'eat WITH a spoon' — asbob uchun WITH.

'to serve food' = ovqat tortmoq.
'ON a plate' — tarelka YUZASIDA → ON.

'to cut' = kesmoq.
Talaffuz: knife /naɪf/ — 'k' O'QILMAYDI.
Ko'pligi: KNIVES.

items.textEn: 4  We pick up food with a ............ .
items.whyUz:
'to pick up' = olmoq, ko'tarmoq.
Vilka bilan go'sht va sabzavot olinadi.

'to fry' = yog'da qovurmoq.
'IN a frying-pan' — tova ICHIDA → IN.
fry + -ing + pan (chiziqcha bilan).

groups.explanationUz: Otga -y qo'shilib ta'm va sifat bildiruvchi so'z yasaladi.
Ikki so'z chiziqcha bilan birikib sifat yasaydi.
Sanalmaydigan otni sanash uchun maxsus so'z kerak.

groups.ruleUz: Bir xil yoziladi — ot va fe'l

groups.explanationUz: Yozilishi va o'qilishi mos kelmaydigan so'zlar.

patterns.formula: There are a lot of + ot + TO CHOOSE FROM, SUCH AS + misollar.
patterns.exampleEn: There are a lot of tasty dishes to choose from, such as pepper steak and roast chicken.
patterns.exampleUz: Tanlash uchun ko'p mazali taomlar bor: masalan, qalampirli bifshteks va qovurilgan tovuq.
patterns.explanationUz:
'such as' = masalan (misol keltirish).
'to choose from' = tanlash uchun.

patterns.formula: DON'T MISS the chance TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to try Laura's home-made bread.
patterns.exampleUz: Uyda pishirilgan nonni tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini qo'ldan boy bermang.
patterns.explanationUz: Buyruq gapning inkori. 'chance TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

patterns.formula: For dessert, have + a slice of / a bowl of + shirinlik.
patterns.exampleEn: For dessert, have a slice of apple pie or a bowl of ice-cream.
patterns.exampleUz: Shirinlikka bir bo'lak olmali pirog yoki bir kosa muzqaymoq oling.
patterns.explanationUz:
'FOR dessert' — 'for' predlogi shart.
Miqdor iborasi: a slice OF, a bowl OF.

patterns.exampleEn: The restaurant is open from eleven in the morning till eleven in the evening.
patterns.exampleUz: Restoran ertalab soat 11 dan kechqurun soat 11 gacha ochiq.

patterns.exampleEn: It is very busy, so don't forget to book a table first.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda gavjum, shuning uchun avval stol band qilishni unutmang.
patterns.explanationUz:
'so' = shuning uchun (natija).
'don't forget TO + fe'l' — 'to' shart.

patterns.formula: We eat/cut/pick up food WITH a + asbob.  /  We fry eggs IN a frying-pan.
patterns.exampleEn: We eat soup with a spoon. We fry eggs in a frying-pan.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz sho'rvani qoshiq bilan yeymiz. Tuxumni tovada qovuramiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
ASBOB uchun WITH.
IDISH ICHIDA bo'lsa IN.
Idish YUZASIDA bo'lsa ON (on a plate).
